article_title: Flipped online teaching of histology and embryology with design thinking: design, practice and reflection.
citation: Guo Yan, Wang Xiaomei, Gao Yang, Yin Haiyan, Ma Qun, Chen Ting. (2024). Flipped online teaching of histology and embryology with design thinking: design, practice and reflection. BMC Medical Education. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12909-024-05373-7
title: O-PIRTAS six-step flipped classroom model
description: The study implements a flipped classroom model formed and adjusted on the basis of Professor Jianpeng Guo's "O-PIRTAS" model, comprising six steps: Objective (low- and high-level Bloom's objectives), Preparation, Instructional video, Review, Activity, and Summary. The article states "The six steps of flipping the classroom link form a closed loop" (Fig. 2), linking pre-class online preparation to in-class high-level activities. In this study it structures the flipped sessions whose outcomes are evaluated in the claims above.
requirements: Pre-class video and preparation materials must be designed and distributed in advance
Classroom activities must target high-level teaching objectives
target_learning_goals: Histology and embryology knowledge objectives at memory through creation levels
examples: Respiratory system and female reproductive system chapters were flipped: students prepared pre-class, group spokespersons demonstrated knowledge points by drawing lots, teams gave feedback, and the teacher guided and summarized.
